caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent, shallow glass dish or pedestal bowl centered within a rectangular border. The dish has a wide, circular rim that gently curves inward, a shallow bowl, and a thick, round base. The glass dish is rendered using shades of blue, green, and white, with highlights and reflections giving it a realistic appearance. The background is a plain, off-white color with the dish sitting on a flat surface, implied by a horizontal green line passing behind the dish at the lower third of the rectangular border. The border itself is composed of thin, green lines that frame the composition, and there are faint stains or discoloration marks visible in the upper left and right corners of the paper.
title: Shallow Compote
